data.title: Flora Isle
data.about:
Flora Isle at Dubai Islands by Flora Isle Real Estate Development is an upcoming residential project. This exquisite development consists of three towers, built on an expansive plot area of 43,419 square meters. Designed with modern lifestyles in mind, the project offers a combination of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, totaling 251 luxurious units. Flora Isle's well-thought-out features include two passenger elevators and one dedicated service elevator, ensuring seamless vertical transportation for residents and staff.

The low-rise buildings boast a diverse range of amenities designed for both indoor and outdoor indulgence. The basement houses premium indoor facilities, ideal for year-round activities and social gatherings. The ground floor provides beautifully landscaped outdoor spaces, offering a tranquil environment for relaxation and recreation. Residents of Flora Isle will enjoy the perfect blend of contemporary living and serene surroundings, making it a coveted address for those seeking comfort and convenience in the heart of Dubai Islands.

characteristics_module.title: Flora Isle at Dubai Islands - 8 Steps to the Shore!
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Beachfront Location: Direct access to Dubai Islands' pristine beaches and stunning sea views.
  • Renowned Architectural Design: Created by J T+P Architects, blending elegance with modern functionality.
  • Variety of Living Spaces: Offers 251 luxurious apartments with 1, 2, and 3-bedroom configurations.
  • Exclusive Amenities: Indoor facilities in the basement and outdoor recreational spaces on the ground floor.
  • Efficient Transportation: Equipped with two passenger elevators and one dedicated service elevator.
  • Expansive Plot: Spanning a generous 43,419 square meters for spacious living and community areas.
  • Low-rise Towers: B+G+7 configuration for an intimate and community-focused residential experience.

location_tile.title: The New Beachfront Residences at Dubai Island
location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Dubai Islands is a breathtaking coastal destination featuring five meticulously designed isles. Developed by Nakheel, this visionary project will include luxurious resorts, pristine beaches, cultural hubs, and world-class amenities. 

With over 60 kilometers of stunning waterfront and more than 20 kilometers of beaches, including a prestigious Blue Flag-certified beach, Dubai Islands promises an unparalleled living experience. The destination also boasts nearly two kilometers of parks, expansive open spaces, and premium golf courses overlooking the Arabian Gulf. Surrounded by world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options, Dubai Islands is where Arabian splendor meets modern sophistication—a true masterpiece of luxury living.

  • Dubai Marina: 15 minutes
  • Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR): 15 minutes
  • Palm Jumeirah: 20 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai: 25 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport (DXB): 30 minutes
